posts.name: Superset Mobile
posts.tagline: Your coding agents, now in your pocket
posts.description: Orchestrate coding agents from your iPhone. Pick up the same workspaces from your computer, review diffs, and merge PRs away from your desk. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other terminal agents. Included with Superset Pro. First month free with code MOBILELAUNCH.

posts.name: Jev
posts.tagline: Fast, structured AI decisions for software automation
posts.description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One frontier model: unstructured state in, typed probabilistic decisions out. Instead of generating text, Jev returns Choice, Score, and Noul answers with calibrated probabilities your code can act on. Parallel sampling delivers ~70-500ms responses, about 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than comparable LLM workflows, with output tokens free. Now available to everyone at console.typesafe.ai with no waitlist.

posts.name: Arcjet
posts.tagline: Secure the AI agents you're building at runtime
posts.description: Arcjet is the runtime security platform that ships in your AI code. Detect prompt injection, authorize agent tool calls, redact sensitive data, and block bots and abuse. Real-time security building blocks you call inside your app, before an action happens.

posts.name: Sai
posts.tagline: The autonomous computer fleet at your command
posts.description: Sai is the world's first robosecretary that works with a fleet of autonomous computers, doing your endless screen work. Each computer navigates software the way you do: reads the screen, clicks the button, types in the form. Trained to interact with the computer interface, Sai automates software even when they lack APIs: legacy desktop apps, internal portals, anything behind a login. Sai supports Windows, macOS and Linux. 73% on OSWorld.

posts.name: Hyrax AI
posts.tagline: The AI architect for your entire codebase
posts.description: Code review tools tell you what’s wrong with a PR. Hyrax finds what should improve across your entire codebase and does the work. It builds deep context around your architecture and conventions, prioritizes issues across six engineering domains, writes each fix in context, verifies it against your tests and checks, and opens a GitHub PR for your team to review and merge.

posts.name: Google Flow for iOS & Android
posts.tagline: Google's AI creative studio now on mobile
posts.description: Transform ideas into reality using Google’s advanced generative models for cinematic video, images, & tools, right from your phone. Use direct camera roll and live camera uploads to ground your image and video generations in your own personal experiences. It’s now easier than ever to pull inspiration from your camera roll or photos and videos captured in the moment. And with cross-device project syncing, you take your creative work wherever you go.

posts.name: CC
posts.tagline: Shared agent that helps keep your family in sync
posts.description: CC is Google Labs’ shared AI agent for families and households. Up to six people can each choose what to share, then CC keeps everyone aligned on the day ahead and takes care of the small logistical work that usually gets lost between inboxes.

posts.name: Sell to State
posts.tagline: Search 3M government contracts in 64 countries
posts.description: Structured government procurement data around the globe — tenders, suppliers and agencies. We help you research what governments around the world buy and find new opportunities to sell to them. No need to get a foreign company or e-signature before deciding there's money to be made. Browse for free; a flat fee unlocks the full dataset, saved searches, REST API and MCP.

posts.name: AI Creative Insights by Decode
posts.tagline: Predict which ad wins before you spend on media
posts.description: Upload any ad, banner, OOH, or video creative and AI Creative Insights predicts how people will respond before your media budget goes live. Get attention heatmaps showing where eyes land first, second-by-second emotion curves, and prescriptive suggestions on what to change and why. Benchmark against category norms, compare variants side by side, and use Synthetic Audience to see predictions persona by persona. Built by Entropik, the team behind Decode.

posts.name: Turfs
posts.tagline: Keep content across your Mac organized in defined areas
posts.description: Use the desktop to keep content from across your Mac accessible and organized in defined areas — or simply keep it clutter-free. A turf can be backed by a real folder, a Finder tag, or your hand-picked selection of files and folders. Turfs stay put through Show Desktop; you choose what Mission Control does with them. Quit, and the desktop is exactly as it was. It replaces Finder's own desktop icon layer, so it can never be sandboxed or sold on the Mac App Store. $29 once, 10-day trial, no card.

posts.name: Flicka
posts.tagline: Launch-ready product demos, from a Chrome extension
posts.description: A screen recorder that makes launch-ready demos: auto-zoom on your clicks, backdrops, frames, a webcam layer, MP4 export. A Chrome extension; nothing uploaded.Flicka is now a Chrome extension. Record a tab, your screen, a window, an area or your camera; draw and blur on the page while you record. Your clicks become zooms in the editor, with captions made on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

posts.name: PostSider
posts.tagline: Social media scheduling platform for humans and agents
posts.description: PostSider is a social media publishing platform built for humans and AI agents. Schedule and publish content across 30+ platforms from one place, or connect Claude, Codex, Cursor, or your own agent through MCP, REST API, or SDK. Manage your content calendar, analytics, teams, approvals, and automation without juggling multiple tools.

posts.name: slop-grader
posts.tagline: Jev-AI CLI tool that evaluates text against custom rulesets
posts.description: slop-grader is a rule-based CLI tool that evaluates documents against custom rulesets and produces document scores and line-by-line flags to guide auto-fixing with an AI agent. Use it to catch AI filler in launch copy, to strip buzzwords from landing pages, score narrative flow in launch emails. Flagged lines let agents draft sharper copy. The tool flags outputs prompts so agents can draft fixes.

posts.name: Cronhq
posts.tagline: Cron jobs that actually run
posts.description: Cron jobs fail in silence. Two servers run the same crontab and your billing job fires twice. A job dies and nobody notices for weeks. Cronhq is a scheduler built around one guarantee: exactly-once execution, enforced by Postgres locks — not best-effort. Around it: retries with backoff, HMAC-signed webhooks, heartbeat monitors for jobs we don't run, and alerts that fire once on failure and once on recovery. Rust on Postgres. MIT-licensed, self-hostable, same image we run. Free tier: 5 jobs.

posts.name: Gradio Workflow
posts.tagline: connect nodes to build AI pipelines, powered by Hugging Face
posts.description: Create AI pipelines by connecting nodes. Bring together Hugging Face Spaces, models, datasets, and your own Python functions on a visual canvas - or let AI agents build workflows programmatically. Inspect intermediate inputs and outputs, and swap in better models without rebuilding your workflow. No downloads needed! Share with a URL or run via a REST API.

posts.name: Jevtown
posts.tagline: 10,000 AI readers react to your post before you publish it
posts.description: Write a post, a listing, a product or a headline, and 10,000 computed AI residents read it. The 600 it should matter to see it first, and it reaches the next 1,500 only if more readers were glad than annoyed, so a weak text dies for half a cent and a good one reaches everyone in 14 seconds. You get who stopped, liked, reposted or blocked, by interest, job, age, city and budget; the questions buyers would ask a listing first; and a demand curve over a product's price ladder. No sign-in.

posts.name: Supacut
posts.tagline: Quickly turn interview footage into a rough cut
posts.description: Review hours of interview footage in minutes. Supacut helps documentary and interview editors find the strongest soundbites, organize material by theme, compare answers across interviews, and build a shortlist of selects. Or let Supacut analyze the material, propose narrative directions, and generate an editable rough cut. Export your work and keep editing in your NLE. Spend less time searching through footage and more time shaping the story.

posts.name: Milliseconds.ai
posts.tagline: Fast AI decisions on text and images, via one API
posts.description: Text and images in. Labels, categories, structured fields and decisions out. Meet decision-machine-1, the small model behind milliseconds.ai. Route emails, extract invoice data, apply return policies (or build your hot-dog identification empire). One fast API. $0.04 per million input tokens. Output tokens are free. Get 125M free input tokens every month on test keys.

posts.name: Simha Digital
posts.tagline: SEO workspace that tells you what to fix with a plan
posts.description: Simha is an SEO workspace that tells you what to fix, not just what's wrong. Connect Search Console and Analytics, run a crawl — and get one health score, a plan ordered by traffic at stake, and an AI summary of what changed and why. Then the part no other tool has: we ask AI search engines your key queries and show whether ChatGPT-style answers cite your site, and who gets cited instead. Growth points, Core Web Vitals, an assistant that knows your data. 7 days free.

posts.name: Plume
posts.tagline: Import your old CV, get a polished ATS-ready one in minutes
posts.description: Plume is a free resume builder that turns your old CV (PDF, Word, even a photo) into a polished, ATS-ready resume in minutes. Pick from 43 templates, fine-tune fonts, colors and spacing, check your ATS score and fix issues in one click. Export pixel-perfect PDFs with no watermark, even on the free plan. Pro (€4.99/mo) adds an AI assistant that tailors your CV to each job offer.

posts.name: Lead Sparker
posts.tagline: Turn any brand URL into a ready-to-send insight deck
posts.description: Paste a lead's URL. The Oriane API watches and listens across Instagram and TikTok: untagged mentions, real earned reach, competitor playbooks, live trends. Get a deck in their brand colors, add your note and CTA, send the PDF. Free, no signup.

posts.name: AppGrowthKit
posts.tagline: Automate your App Store Screenshots and print money...
posts.description: AI App Store and Google Play screenshot maker. Device frames, AI layouts and copy, and store-ready export in one click - built for indie devs and teams.

posts.name: OmniDICOM
posts.tagline: DICOM viewing and metadata editing on Mac and Windows
posts.description: Open DICOM studies, edit metadata, and explore MPR, 3D volume rendering and cine on Mac and Windows. OmniDICOM includes PACS/DICOMweb transfer and exports; Professional adds stacked filters and analysis tools. A 14-day trial starts at first launch. Trial exports have limitations. Paid plans start at US$10/month per machine. For research and education, not diagnosis.

posts.name: SecAIQ Watch
posts.tagline: What are your AI tools really doing on your machine?
posts.description: Free, open-source dashboard that shows which AI tools run on your computer, what they connect to, what they can access and how many tokens they use. Local and read-only: no cloud, no account. macOS, Linux, Windows (beta).

posts.name: NiubiGEO
posts.tagline: Open-source AI visibility. Human-powered growth.
posts.description: NiubiGEO combines open-source AI visibility and competitor reports with human-powered product growth. See how AI describes your product, which competitors appear, and inspect original answers and sources. Arrange paid human AI testing, product trials, content creation and distribution through the official platform. Plan tasks and budgets with Growth Canvas, then retest AI visibility. Self-hosted software is free; API, hosting and services cost extra.

posts.name: Refoid
posts.tagline: Automate App Store refund responses and track every outcome
posts.description: Refoid automates App Store refund responses for iOS and macOS developers. Connect your apps, set your response preference, and track each request, response, and Apple’s final decision in one timeline. Get automatic retries and email alerts for confirmed refund declines, with no backend integration or success fees. Apple makes every final refund decision.

posts.name: Osmotic
posts.tagline: Download your DJI Osmo footage to your Mac over Wi-Fi
posts.description: Free, open-source Mac app for DJI Osmo cameras. Pairs over Bluetooth, joins the camera's Wi-Fi and downloads clips into day folders, dated when shot and resumable. Plus remote record, live view and USB webcam. No phone app, no account.

posts.name: Accelerator Comparator
posts.tagline: Compare 400+ startup accelerators and their deal terms
posts.description: Compare 400+ startup accelerators side by side by cheque size, deal terms, stage, industries, focus, and program details. See how much equity they will cost you at a $5M, $10M, or $20M next-round valuation. Free, no signup required!

posts.name: Postraid
posts.tagline: Turn your website into a month of social content
posts.description: Postraid turns your website into on-brand reaction videos, memes, and carousels. Instead of prompting for every post, start with your product, swipe through a batch of ideas, and keep your favorites. Edit, schedule, and publish to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube in one place. Create your first batch free.

posts.name: FasLaunch
posts.tagline: The database of verified AI startups
posts.description: Discover verified AI startups, companies, and products in one searchable database. Find trusted AI startups by industry, category, funding, and location.

posts.name: EzguSavdo
posts.tagline: AI commerce layer for retail systems and sales channels
posts.description: EzguSavdo is an AI commerce layer connecting a retailer's existing systems to the channels where customers buy. It works with 1C, SAP, BILLZ, OX System, Smartup, Odoo and Shopify, and serves Instagram Direct, Telegram, WhatsApp and web chat. The agent answers from catalog, stock and price data, applies the retailer's pricing rules, and creates orders or hands off to a person. A live commerce feed also publishes structured product data for SEO and AI discovery (AEO/GEO).

posts.name: Generous
posts.tagline: The agent that buys the right gift on time, every time
posts.description: Generous is the first AI agent for gifting. Tell it who you're gifting and it finds real gifts, from real products to the gift cards people actually want, matched to the person, the occasion, and your budget. Line up the occasions that matter and it remembers the dates, so you never scramble again. Before anything ships, Gift Glimpse lets your recipient peek and swap for something they'll love even more, inside your budget. One of the first real implementations of agentic commerce.

posts.name: EasyWebsites
posts.tagline: Fully custom websites in minutes, built for SEO & AI search
posts.description: Describe your business in a few lines. Get a custom website with hosting and preconfigured, customizable appointment or reservation forms with email notifications. Connect your domain; we handle ongoing SEO and AI search optimization.

posts.name: Murmur
posts.tagline: Say the idea before it’s gone.
posts.description: A small dot floats over everything on your Mac. Click it, say the idea, press Enter. It lands in Apple Notes, timestamped, synced to your phone. On-device transcription, no account, no cloud, never rewrites your words. Free, 1 MB, on the Mac App Store.

posts.name: Bad Aura
posts.tagline: How unemployable are you based on your socials?
posts.description: Connect your Bluesky and see what your posts give away. Get four adversarial reads: recruiter, influence broker, social engineer and algorithm, plus an Unemployability Factor. Evidence-backed findings include quotes; unsupported impressions are labelled.

posts.name: Nabsun
posts.tagline: Open-source AI browser with a local model built in
posts.description: An open-source Chromium browser with an assistant that works in the tabs you already have open — reading, clicking, filling fields. It ships a local model (Qwen3 1.7B) that runs on your CPU with no account or API key, and works offline. Or point it at Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, or the Claude Code / Codex CLI you already use. Anything that changes something asks you first. It's also an MCP server, so your editor can drive your real signed-in browser. MIT licensed.

posts.name: MRRKit
posts.tagline: Your MRR, always in sight
posts.description: Your MRR, always in sight. Stripe, RevenueCat, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, App Store Connect and Google Play in one gorgeous dashboard — with widgets, Apple Watch complications, projections and a ping for every sale.

posts.name: Mediora-AI - One Idea, Every Platform
posts.tagline: Turn one idea into platform-ready content with AI
posts.description: Mediora-AI helps creators, founders, marketers, and businesses turn one idea into platform-ready social content. Enter your idea once, choose your platforms, and AI adapts the content to each platform’s format, tone, and audience. Create for LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook and more from one workspace.

posts.name: WattAI
posts.tagline: Free Decision Intelligence
posts.description: WattAI is an on-device decision model. Send it text and a list of options, and get back the option that fits, plus a calibrated probability for each. No text generation, no JSON parsing, no data leaving your device. Open source, self-hostable, and available through a free API.

posts.name: Kinlet: Baby book & family keepsakes
posts.tagline: App that turns family memories into a baby book
posts.description: Built by parents, Kinlet replaces baby-book guilt with effortless, private memory keeping. Capture authentic micro-moments in seconds through daily prompts, voice notes, photos, and video clips. While Photo Rewind surfaces forgotten memories, Guided Highlights automatically organize your entries into an elegant hardcover heirloom book via our web Design Studio. You get structured guidance when you want it and instant capture when you don't, no blank pages, just real life, preserved.

posts.name: Radiobreak
posts.tagline: Your personal, AI-generated daily newscast.
posts.description: You want to stay informed, but traditional radio is on a schedule you can't control, and podcasts are just "replays" that aren't localized to your world. Meet Radiobreak — the first agentic media network that auto-generates a live, radio-style news program just for you. We bridge the gap between live radio and on-demand audio. When you hit play, Radiobreak synthesizes national news, local headlines, weather, and personal interests—seamlessly stitched together with an announcer of your choice.

posts.name: check-docs
posts.tagline: Catch stale CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md references before commit
posts.description: check-docs is a small shell pre-commit check that stops commits when CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, or imported files reference missing paths or deleted names. It checks the Git index, follows nested instruction files and @imports, and catches unstaged instruction-file edits. MIT licensed and tested on macOS and Ubuntu under sh, dash, and bash.

posts.name: Dominicana Icons
posts.tagline: Line icons inspired by the Dominican Republic 🇩🇴
posts.description: A line icon library inspired by the Dominican Republic, built for React, Angular, and Blazor. Search, customize, and download each icon in SVG or PNG for your websites, apps, dashboards, and digital products.

posts.name: Invoice Studio
posts.tagline: Edit the markdown and CSS for your invoice, Generate a PDF.
posts.description: Invoice is a free invoice generator for people who want full control of the layout. Edit the content in Markdown and the look in CSS, then generate a printable PDF in seconds. No signup, no template lock-in. Freelancers and small businesses can bill from the browser; developers can clone the repo and run npm run generate from the terminal.

posts.name: BillFast
posts.tagline: Polished invoices for freelancers, minus accounting bloat
posts.description: BillFast is a lightweight invoice generator for freelancers and solo businesses. Add a client, line items, tax, currency, and payment instructions; check the live preview; then download a ready-to-send PDF. Free includes 3 watermarked PDF downloads. Pro is £7/month for unlimited downloads and watermark-free invoices. Built for independent designers, developers, writers, consultants, and other freelancers who need an invoice instead of a full accounting suite. Available in English and Russian.

posts.name: Tamoia
posts.tagline: A CRM with no seats. You pay for what got done.
posts.description: Every firm has paid for seats nobody logged into. Tamoia has no seats. Connect any agent over MCP. Every action it takes goes on the record with a timestamp and a source flag. You pay per verified result. Setup runs about 20 minutes.

posts.name: KyvoLab
posts.tagline: KyvoLab is a software development company
posts.description: KyvoLab a product lab designing and engineering fintech apps for African startups. Brand identity, UI design, and mobile engineering.

posts.name: Quarterback
posts.tagline: Automate your AI manager pipeline for agentic workflows
posts.description: Coding agents say "done" when the job isn't finished, a requirement skipped, onboarding bypassed, an unrelated file touched. Quarterback compiles your request into a task contract, then independently verifies the result against it. Deterministic checks first, AI judgment second.

posts.name: SyncIt
posts.tagline: Find a time everyone can make
posts.description: SyncIt helps friends, families and teams agree on a time with shared availability, time polls and group calendars. Guests can respond without creating an account. Share availability without revealing private event details, then schedule the plan. Available on web, iOS and Android, with a free plan and optional paid upgrades.

posts.name: imado
posts.tagline: A real inbox on any domain you own — free for 3
posts.description: Every side project needs an email address, but Google Workspace charges per seat per domain, and forwarding services can't actually reply as the address. imado gives any domain you own a real inbox: paste in the DNS records it hands you, then send and receive from hello@yourdomain.com in the browser. DKIM-signed, unlimited addresses per domain, no per-seat pricing ever. 3 domains free, permanently — not a trial. Builder is $39/year for 20 domains. Webmail today, IMAP next.

posts.name: neurodance
posts.tagline: Creative software that compounds every campaign
posts.description: Neurodance is creative software for making, managing, publishing and learning from marketing content in one place.

posts.name: BookWard - Read, Remember, Discover
posts.tagline: A reading app that remembers why you loved a book
posts.description: ate books and note why. BookWard uses your reasons to rank your Want to read list, suggest what to read next, and write a Book Companion for any title, with PDF and Google Drive export. Free beta.

posts.name: ClassOnline
posts.tagline: Run your own online teaching business
posts.description: ClassOnline helps educators run their own online teaching business. Create and sell classes, manage schedules and students, and teach on a shared blackboard with documents, graphs and recording. Studio tools, earnings and invoices support the work around each lesson. An ongoing free plan is available, with paid usage and features.

posts.name: ZvonAI
posts.tagline: AI receptionist that answers your phone in Polish, 24/7
posts.description: An AI receptionist for Polish businesses. Answers the phone in Polish, English, Ukrainian and Russian, around the clock. Books appointments, answers questions from your own price list and documents, and passes real callers to you. Built for clinics, law firms and salons that lose customers to a phone nobody picks up.

posts.name: FUZZ.VC
posts.tagline: We try to break your startup before investors do.
posts.description: Independent adversarial stress-testing for startups. FUZZ reconstructs your business logic, finds a credible way to break it, and can rebuild and attack it again.

posts.name: Cenntre
posts.tagline: Publish, build your audience, and earn on your own terms
posts.description: Cenntre brings publishing, audience building, and creator monetization into one platform. Creators can publish text, image, video, audio, PDFs, and polls, then monetize through subscriptions, tips, pledges, and pay-per-view content. Creators also get dedicated fan and subscriber lists, a creator insight dashboard, and tools to manage their content and monetization from one place.

posts.name: The Engine
posts.tagline: AI sales, marketing and content workflows — in beta
posts.description: The Engine brings AI sales, marketing and content workflows together for high-ticket businesses. Explore a demo at theengine.dev and join the waitlist. The product is currently in beta, with public opening planned for October 15, 2026.

posts.name: Bolus
posts.tagline: Calculators and drug sheets app for nurses and midwives
posts.description: Bolus is the first calculators and drug sheets app especially for French nurses and midwives. What you need to prepare, administer and survey treatments, on the field. Built by an ER nurse who knows the difficulty of finding fast informations and preparing drugs under pressure.

posts.name: Designeng.tools
posts.tagline: Curated design inspiration, tools, resources & UI references
posts.description: DesignEng.tools is a curated hub for design engineers, bringing together the best design inspiration, UI references, component libraries, tools, icons, branding resources, creators, and more. Discover useful resources for designing and building better digital products, explore new ideas, find the right tools for your workflow, and follow talented creators—all organized in one place.

posts.name: Client SQL
posts.tagline: Control PostgreSQL Access for People and Coding Clients
posts.description: Client SQL controls PostgreSQL access for people and coding clients. Set scoped permissions, review writes, approve commit-bound Liquibase migrations, and keep an audit record for every governed action.

posts.name: zep.js
posts.tagline: Tiny event pipeline with autocleanup, debounce & AbortSignal
posts.description: Zep.js is an ultra-lightweight (265 bytes gzipped), zero-dependency JavaScript utility that turns event listeners into clean, reactive pipelines with automatic lifecycle management and debouncing. What makes Zep.js standout? - Ultra-lightweight: Only 265 bytes gzipped. - Built-in Auto-Cleanup. - Integrated Debouncing & Filtering. - Race-Condition Proof. - Avoids event-handling plumbing & boilerplate entirely.

posts.name: scrape.land
posts.tagline: Scraping and proxy tunneling made easy
posts.description: Turn any web page into clean structured data. One API key, country targeting, sticky sessions, and the exact fields you ask for from $0.139 per 1k requests. AI processor included.

posts.name: Penholder
posts.tagline: Get your priorities right
posts.description: Everything is a priority, so put them in order. The team suggests, one person holds the pen, a line marks the real work. $5 a month or $50 a year per team.

posts.name: Toads
posts.tagline: A better Screen Recorder for Busy Founders
posts.description: I built the screen recorder I wanted for my Mac. Native Mac screen recorder + real editor. Record your screen, camera, iphone / add video/replace speaker/ transcribe. all the things. Fast, local, private, and built for people who want great-looking recordings without another subscription. $29.99 once.

posts.name: SpaceFree
posts.tagline: Developer Storage debugger for Windows
posts.description: SpaceFree scans your Windows drive and shows where the space went: WSL2 and Docker virtual disks, package caches and build folders. It tags what is safe to delete, uses the Recycle Bin by default, and runs fully on your machine. Free for 7 days.

posts.name: Dream
posts.tagline: Desktop IDE for working with multiple AI coding agents.
posts.description: Dream is a local-first desktop workspace for building with AI coding agents. Work with Claude, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in one place, with chat, files, a terminal, browser previews, and diff review together. Choose your agent, work on your own projects, and move from prompt to working app without constantly switching tools.

posts.name: Visitqo
posts.tagline: Understand your website. Without the analytics overload.
posts.description: Understand your visitors, traffic, content, and AI-driven discovery through one intelligent analytics platform. 7-day trial, no credit card.

posts.name: RestShade
posts.tagline: Water · Rest · Shade - We handle the rest.
posts.description: RestShade watches heat, wildfire smoke, and cold at every job site. Most days you do nothing. When a threshold crosses, it flags the site, shows the state duties that triggered, and keeps the signed log. English and Spanish plans, training, acclimatization names, and an inspector packet sit next to the daily record. For roofing, landscaping, construction, agriculture, warehouses, and kitchens. Packs for California, Oregon, Washington, Maryland, Nevada, Minnesota, Colorado, and OSHA Heat NEP.

posts.name: CreoFeedback: AI YouTube Grow
posts.tagline: AI Channel Analysis + Real Viewer Feedback for Creators
posts.description: CreoFeedback is the ultimate growth toolkit for YouTube creators. Get a detailed AI-powered report card of your channel — subscribers, views, and engagement insights. But that's not all: test your thumbnails, titles, and video intros with real viewers before you publish. Earn points by giving feedback, and spend them to grow your own channel. No guesswork. Just real feedback and real growth. 100% Real human.

posts.name: Design Tool
posts.tagline: Figma's inspect panel, for any website
posts.description: Hover any element on a live website and read its type styles the way you would in Figma. Click two elements to measure the exact gap between them as dimension lines, not a ruler you eyeball. See margin, border and padding as a spacing box instead of a flat CSS list. Reach past full-bleed overlay elements with a Cmd/Ctrl-hover. No host permission, no tracking, no network requests — nothing leaves your browser.

posts.name: SplitFree
posts.tagline: A free, open-source Splitwise alternative for Android
posts.description: SplitFree is a free, open-source Splitwise alternative for Android. Track shared expenses, choose equal or custom splits, and see who owes whom. Works offline, with encrypted sync through Nostr relays or nearby phones. No signup or subscription.

posts.name: Intentt: Habits, Tasks and Focus
posts.tagline: Local-first task, habit & Pomodoro tracker. Offline, no ads
posts.description: Intentt is an all-in-one habit tracker, task manager, and focus timer — built with an intent to collect no account, no data, no tracking, and show no ads. ✅ Habits — flexible schedules, measurable goals, streaks, Holiday Mode 📋 Tasks — priorities, subtasks, due dates, calendar strip ⏱ Focus — Pomodoro timer, Focus Mode, ambient sounds 📊 Insights — streaks, trends, completion rates 100% offline. Your data never leaves your device. One-time Pro upgrade, no subscription.

posts.name: PostgreSQL Academy
posts.tagline: Master PostgreSQL Through Real Examples
posts.description: Master PostgreSQL with hands-on lessons, quizzes, and real-world examples. From basics to advanced queries — start learning today.

posts.name: Prime SaaS
posts.tagline: Build Your SaaS 10x Faster
posts.description: Prime SaaS fills a gap in the market with a modern, production-ready boilerplate built on Node.js, React, and Material UI. It combines an up-to-date technology stack with essential features such as CI/CD pipelines, E2E Testing, and a nice theming system—giving developers a solid foundation without the need to build and integrate these components from scratch.

posts.name: Polo Prompt
posts.tagline: Free AI prompt library + generators, no sign-up
posts.description: PoloPrompt is a free toolkit for anyone using ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini who doesn't want to reinvent prompts from scratch every time. Browse a searchable library of ready-made prompts, or use one of six interactive generators that build a fully customized prompt from a few inputs — no prompt-engineering experience needed. No sign-up, no paywall, no limits.

posts.name: Image to pixel art
posts.tagline: Convert images into pixel art
posts.description: Convert any image to pixel art for free. 100% browser-based with no uploads to a server, no account needed, and no watermarks on downloads.

posts.name: Vibe Check for AI-Built Apps
posts.tagline: (Free) Is your AI-built app ready to launch?
posts.description: Vibe Check helps builders using AI coding tools understand whether their app is ready for real users. Get a plain-English launch readiness report covering critical risks, missing pieces, what to fix first, what can wait, and next prompts to use in your AI editor.

posts.name: HRYP AI Hiring Readiness Check
posts.tagline: Find AI hiring risks and readiness gaps in 5 minutes
posts.description: A free 22-question assessment for companies using AI in recruitment. Identify governance gaps, human-oversight issues and EU AI Act readiness concerns, get an instant result, and optionally order a personalized report.

posts.name: Mehaniko
posts.tagline: AI Car Diagnostics
posts.description: Find out what is wrong with your car in seconds. Mehaniko uses advanced AI for fast, accurate vehicle diagnostics — before you go to a mechanic.

posts.name: LumaGain
posts.tagline: The secret behind brighter product photos and social ads
posts.description: Most people do not search for Ultra HDR—they notice that some photos look brighter and have more pop. LumaGain turns an existing product photo into one compatible JPEG: choose the highlights that should stand out, preview the result, and export. On supported screens and apps, those highlights can look brighter; elsewhere, the same file remains viewable. Built for marketers, creators, and small brands that want more eye-catching product images without learning the display technology.

posts.name: Cliptray
posts.tagline: Best clipboard management tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux
posts.description: ClipTray is a simple and fast clipboard manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux that keeps everything you copy in one place. Search your clipboard history, pin important clips, organize them with tags, edit text before pasting, and access your clips whenever you need them. Built for developers, creators, and anyone who copies and pastes a lot. Copy once. Find it whenever you need it. 🚀

posts.name: BoilerIQ
posts.tagline: Every power engineering ticket. One place to study for it.
posts.description: BoilerIQ is Manitoba's first platform combining Guarded Status compliance, relief power engineer staffing, and exam prep in one place — built specifically around the Power Engineers Act, not adapted from generic software. Standout features: signed daily compliance logs, 3rd/4th Class relief coverage for vacations and emergencies, and free SOPEEC-aligned practice exams. One team handles it all, instead of juggling separate vendors.

posts.name: Choppy
posts.tagline: The pilot logbook that fills itself from your airline roster
posts.description: Offline-first pilot logbook for iPhone, iPad, Android and web. Import published rosters from 80+ airlines (PDF, CSV, XML, TXT) so flights log themselves; bring your history from LogTen, CrewLounge, ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot or MyFlightbook. Night time split to the minute, guided EASA flight time limitation check, FCL.060 / FAA 61.57 recency, licence and medical expiry, METAR/TAF/NOTAM, a map of every route flown. Built by an airline pilot. Free for your first 100 flights.

posts.name: AI Album Cover Maker
posts.tagline: Create release-ready album covers from a prompt or photo
posts.description: AI Album Cover Maker turns a song title, genre, mood, or artist photo into polished square cover art for singles, EPs, mixtapes, playlists, and albums. Unlike generic image generators, it is built for music releases: streaming-ready 1:1 composition, clear title space, genre-aware art direction, remixable templates, reference-image support, and conversational revisions. Start with free credits, refine in chat, then download for Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, and release campaigns.

posts.name: Panna
posts.tagline: Buy & sell verified second-hand books across India.
posts.description: Buy and sell quality-checked used and new books at honest prices with condition verification, instant book buyback quotes, and pan-India delivery.Panna is India’s marketplace for verified second-hand and new books. Buy quality-checked titles at up to 70% off MRP, or clear your shelf by selling old books for instant cash and doorstep pickup. Every good book deserves a second reader.

posts.name: Cloudline
posts.tagline: Google Analytics alternative without cookies
posts.description: A lightweight Google Analytics alternative without cookies or IP storage. Track real-time visitors, pages, traffic sources, engagement, clicks, scroll depth and funnels with an under-2KB script. Built by Om Yaduvanshi. Free for early users

posts.name: CommentGrab
posts.tagline: Turn YouTube comments into images and animated clips.
posts.description: CommentGrab is a free Chrome extension that lets you click comments on YouTube and turn them into clean images and short animated clips, redrawn from the text so they stay sharp at any size. No account, no servers.

posts.name: Domihélie
posts.tagline: Room temperatures of your home without AC, today or in 2100
posts.description: Domihélie estimates the natural temperature of four rooms of your home — no heating, no AC — from a physical model (walls, insulation, windows, orientation) fed by real weather, anywhere on Earth, today or in 2030, 2050 and 2100 (IPCC). Bilingual, no account.

posts.name: Unpaged
posts.tagline: Want to know more about something? Navigate into that.
posts.description: Documents used to be flat. Unpaged gives them depth. Anything you put on a canvas can open into a whole canvas of its own, so the big picture stays clean and the detail is one click away. Want to know more about something? Navigate into that. Share it and edit live with your team, comment, present. Built-in MCP server: Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code can create and edit documents with you. Has a free tier. Try it even without an account at unpaged.io/try.

posts.name: Pipeline
posts.tagline: The CRM for service businesses.
posts.description: Pipeline is lead and job management software for UK trades and service businesses. Capture every enquiry, track every follow-up and turn more leads into paying work - then manage the quotes, bookings, jobs, invoices and payments that follow. Everything stays in one place, instead of being scattered across spreadsheets, sticky notes and a WhatsApp group called "JOBS". Flat monthly pricing. No per-seat nonsense. And far fewer conversations beginning with, "Did anyone ever call that customer back?"

posts.name: PracticeSIEM
posts.tagline: Learn SOC and Defend Your Servers
posts.description: Investigate security incidents using the real logs and a working search console.Runs in the browser.

posts.name: SQLazy
posts.tagline: Lazy to write,rigorous in outcome
posts.description: Write complex SQL step-by-step in natural language — then compile it into auditable SQL. SQLazy turns AI-assisted query building into a transparent and verifiable process, eliminating black-box SQL generation.

posts.name: Rini
posts.tagline: Hire a digital person for the work you'd rather not do
posts.description: Hire a digital person for any role. Give it a name, a personality, and the tools it can use, and Rini works across your email, websites, code, and platforms like a real teammate.

posts.name: Dashly
posts.tagline: Cookieless. Analytics that don't lie.
posts.description: Cookieless, bot-free web analytics for founders. See real visitors, true sources, and what made them buy — no cookies, no consent banner, no inflated numbers. Free trial.

posts.name: Linkitin
posts.tagline: Your personal profile, all your links, one beautiful page.
posts.description: Linkitin turns your online identity into one beautiful, shareable profile. Add your photo, bio, socials, links, professional identity and Spotify song — then share one link everywhere. No signup, no complicated setup. Just create your profile, customize it and share. Built by Samartha Gs

posts.name: GetPaidly
posts.tagline: Get Paid. Without the Chase. From Due to Paid. Automatically
posts.description: Hey hunters, Stop chasing payments. Auto WhatsApp reminders, UPI links, AI verification. Setup in 30 seconds - just say Hi. GetPaidly helps all businesses/individuals collect overdue payments faster with automated WhatsApp reminders. Send polite, professional payment follow-ups where your customers actually read them - WhatsApp messages see 98% open rates vs 20% for email. Track dues, send payment links with UPI support, and get real-time payment status updates. Works in English, Hindi and more.

posts.name: Jevfast
posts.tagline: Discover Jev projects, videos, and ideas to build on
posts.description: Discover what people are building with Jev, TypeSafe's AI model for typed decisions inside software. Jevfast curates projects and videos in one place. Browse by category, explore realtime uses with the call-frequency filter, and submit your own work.

posts.name: Teenstore
posts.tagline: Trendy clothing, built by teens, for teens.
posts.description: TeenStore is a teen-built clothing startup creating affordable, trend-led hoodies, tees and more for teens. Discover fresh designs, shop online and get your fits delivered across India.

posts.name: Ododok 1.6
posts.tagline: Mindful eating, measured with AirPods
posts.description: Ododok is now live on the App Store. Since our first launch, it has grown from a real-time chew counter into a daily mindful-eating companion. Track meals with Live Activities, turn food photos into a playful home table, review detected foods, calories, and daily or weekly trends, then build consistency with missions, streaks, reminders, and Odi’s acorn rewards. No extra wearable—just supported AirPods and an iPhone.
